sentences.en: Philae landed and then bounced for 2 hours before landing again.
sentences.zh: 菲莱着陆后又弹跳了两个小时才再次着陆。

sentences.en: The children started bouncing up and down on the couch.
sentences.zh: 孩子们开始在沙发上上下晃动。

sentences.en: The bullets bounced off the side of the armoured car.
sentences.zh: 子弹从装甲车侧面反弹开来。
